summary: Three independent stdlib-only components (dijkstra, nthprime, windscale) with per-module tests, split into three non-overlapping process cards.

processes.title: 实现 dijkstra.py 有向图最短路径与 tests/test_dijkstra.py
processes.scope: Owns only dijkstra.py and tests/test_dijkstra.py. Does not touch nthprime, windscale, any existing file, or any team/** path. Stdlib only; must not import the other two modules.
processes.task:
Create dijkstra.py (new file only, do not modify any existing file) implementing the work order's Dijkstra spec, plus tests/test_dijkstra.py covering every acceptance item.

Spec (verbatim requirements):
- Graph is a dict: keys are node names (str), values are adjacency dicts (neighbor name -> weight). Edges are directed as given; nodes appearing only as neighbors (not as keys) have no outgoing edges. Weights must be int/float (bool rejected); non-numeric raises TypeError; negative weight raises ValueError; non-dict graph, non-dict adjacency, or non-str node name raises TypeError.
- dijkstra(graph, source) -> tuple[dict, dict]: returns (dist, prev). dist contains every node in the graph (appearing as key or as neighbor): reachable nodes hold the shortest distance (source is 0), unreachable nodes hold math.inf. prev contains only the mapping of reachable non-source nodes to their predecessor (source and unreachable nodes are not in prev). source not in graph raises ValueError.
- shortest_path(graph, source, target) -> list: returns the shortest path node list from source to target (both ends included); unreachable returns []; source == target returns [source]; source or target not in graph raises ValueError.

Acceptance items (each needs a corresponding test case, transcribed exactly):
- Graph G1 = {"A": {"B": 1, "C": 4}, "B": {"C": 2, "D": 5}, "C": {"D": 1}, "D": {}, "E": {}}: dijkstra(G1, "A") dist is A=0, B=1, C=3, D=4, E=math.inf; prev == {"B": "A", "C": "B", "D": "C"}; shortest_path(G1, "A", "D") == ["A", "B", "C", "D"]; shortest_path(G1, "A", "C") == ["A", "B", "C"]; shortest_path(G1, "A", "E") == []; shortest_path(G1, "A", "A") == ["A"]; shortest_path(G1, "D", "A") == [] (directed, not reversible).
- Graph G2 = {"S": {"T": 2.5, "U": 1.5}, "U": {"T": 0.5}, "T": {}}: dist["T"] == 2.0, dist["U"] == 1.5, prev == {"U": "S", "T": "U"}, shortest_path(G2, "S", "T") == ["S", "U", "T"].
- Graph G3 = {"A": {"B": 7}}: dist["B"] == 7, prev == {"B": "A"}.
- dijkstra({"A": {"B": -1}}, "A"), dijkstra(G1, "Z"), shortest_path(G1, "A", "Z") raise ValueError.
- dijkstra([("A", {})], "A"), dijkstra({"A": {"B": "x"}}, "A"), dijkstra({"A": {"B": True}}, "A") raise TypeError.

Deliverables: only dijkstra.py and tests/test_dijkstra.py (both new; never edit existing files). Standard library only.

processes.title: 实现 nthprime.py 第 n 个素数与 tests/test_nthprime.py
processes.scope: Owns only nthprime.py and tests/test_nthprime.py. Does not touch dijkstra, windscale, any existing file, or any team/** path. Stdlib only; must not import the other two modules.
processes.task:
Create nthprime.py (new file only, do not modify any existing file) implementing the work order's nth-prime spec, plus tests/test_nthprime.py covering every acceptance item.

Spec (verbatim requirements):
- nth_prime(n: int) -> int: 1-based counting (the 1st prime is 2). n must be int (bool rejected); non-int raises TypeError; n < 1 raises ValueError.

Acceptance items (each needs a corresponding test case, transcribed exactly):
- nth_prime(1) == 2; nth_prime(2) == 3; nth_prime(3) == 5; nth_prime(4) == 7; nth_prime(5) == 11; nth_prime(6) == 13; nth_prime(10) == 29; nth_prime(25) == 97; nth_prime(50) == 229; nth_prime(100) == 541; nth_prime(1000) == 7919.
- nth_prime(0), nth_prime(-3) raise ValueError.
- nth_prime(2.0), nth_prime("3"), nth_prime(True) raise TypeError.

Deliverables: only nthprime.py and tests/test_nthprime.py (both new; never edit existing files). Standard library only.

processes.title: 实现 windscale.py 蒲福风级与 tests/test_windscale.py
processes.scope: Owns only windscale.py and tests/test_windscale.py. Does not touch dijkstra, nthprime, any existing file, or any team/** path. Stdlib only; must not import the other two modules.
processes.task:
Create windscale.py (new file only, do not modify any existing file) implementing the work order's Beaufort scale spec, plus tests/test_windscale.py covering every acceptance item.

Spec (verbatim requirements):
- Thresholds pinned (unit km/h, lower bound inclusive, upper bound is the next level's lower bound): level 0 <1; 1: 1–5; 2: 6–11; 3: 12–19; 4: 20–28; 5: 29–38; 6: 39–49; 7: 50–61; 8: 62–74; 9: 75–88; 10: 89–102; 11: 103–117; 12: >=118.
- beaufort(speed_kmh) -> int: speed must be int/float (bool rejected); non-numeric raises TypeError; negative raises ValueError; returns level 0–12.
- beaufort_label(speed_kmh) -> str: returns the Chinese name; levels 0–12 in order are 无风、软风、轻风、微风、和风、清风、强风、疾风、大风、烈风、狂风、暴风、飓风; input validation same as beaufort.

Acceptance items (each needs a corresponding test case, transcribed exactly):
- beaufort(0) == 0; beaufort(0.9) == 0; beaufort(1) == 1; beaufort(5) == 1; beaufort(6) == 2; beaufort(11) == 2; beaufort(12) == 3; beaufort(19) == 3; beaufort(20) == 4; beaufort(28) == 4; beaufort(29) == 5; beaufort(38) == 5; beaufort(39) == 6; beaufort(49) == 6; beaufort(50) == 7; beaufort(61) == 7; beaufort(62) == 8; beaufort(74) == 8; beaufort(75) == 9; beaufort(88) == 9; beaufort(89) == 10; beaufort(102) == 10; beaufort(103) == 11; beaufort(117) == 11; beaufort(118) == 12; beaufort(200) == 12; beaufort(32.5) == 5.
- beaufort_label(0) == "无风"; beaufort_label(3) == "软风"; beaufort_label(30) == "清风"; beaufort_label(55) == "疾风"; beaufort_label(100) == "狂风"; beaufort_label(118) == "飓风".
- beaufort(-1) raises ValueError; beaufort("50"), beaufort(True), beaufort(None) raise TypeError.

Deliverables: only windscale.py and tests/test_windscale.py (both new; never edit existing files). Standard library only.
